subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #97086 as the first official external MXC sandbox plugin with the native `@microsoft/mxc-sdk`/`node-pty` dependency graph and current SDK `--config-base64` argv transport?
rationale: The code shape is now reviewable and opt-in, but accepting native packaged executables, install scripts, and argv-carried sandbox config is a security/product boundary choice automation cannot make.

options.title: Approve exact-head boundary
options.body: Approve the current dependency graph and SDK transport for this prerelease external plugin, then merge after final maintainer/security checks pass.

options.title: Pause for upstream transport
options.body: Hold the PR until MXC provides a non-argv config transport or a stronger upstream mitigation for config exposure.

options.title: Defer official packaging
options.body: Keep MXC outside the official OpenClaw plugin catalog for now and revisit after dependency/security ownership is clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-head boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the current dependency graph and SDK transport for this prerelease external plugin, then merge after final maintainer/security checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer is already requested live and previously shaped the security-sensitive registration and protected skill overlay requirements.
